title: key.rs: supported_key_enc_algorithm() and preferred_digest_algorithm() default methods are never called by the crate
description: Both DecryptionKey::supported_key_enc_algorithm() and SigningKey::preferred_digest_algorithm() provide default implementations returning None, but neither is called anywhere in smime-tree's own code (grep confirms). They form public API surface that the crate itself ignores, creating a false impression of algorithm negotiation. Either: (a) use them in encrypt.rs / sign.rs to drive algorithm selection, or (b) remove them and re-add when there is a concrete caller. Shipping hook methods that the library itself never consults is misleading API.
